recognize_zh: 高倍下以大型中心母細胞（泡狀染色質、近核膜的多個小核仁）為主，混有核有切痕的中心細胞，並有有絲分裂與凋亡小體；大細胞比例高，代表濾泡性淋巴瘤中的高級別區域。
features: Predominance of large centroblasts with round vesicular nuclei and one to three peripheral nucleoli
Scattered mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies
Eosinophilic fibrillary stroma between cells; no starry-sky pattern
describe_en: High-power H&E section of lymph node shows a crowded population composed predominantly of large centroblasts with vesicular chromatin and peripheral small nucleoli, admixed with smaller cleaved centrocytes. Mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies are present, but no starry-sky macrophage pattern is seen. The high proportion of centroblasts in this field would correspond to a high-grade area if present within neoplastic follicles. Findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma with numerous centroblasts; exclusion of a diffuse large B-cell lymphoma component requires correlation with architecture and CD21.

ddx.vs: DLBCL shows diffuse sheets of large cells without FDC meshworks, so architecture and CD21 staining rather than cytology separate it.
Grade 3B follicles contain solid sheets of centroblasts without centrocytes, whereas centrocytes are admixed here.
Reactive centers contain tingible body macrophages with polarization and are BCL2 negative.
